references.text: The Lord had previously told Israel that they had stayed long enough at Mount Horeb and should move on, reflecting the same divine command to end their journey around a certain area.
The context of traveling around Mount Se'ir for many days, which now reaches its conclusion with the command to turn northward.
Israel had to go around the land of Edom, and this verse marks the end of that detour as they are now told to turn northward.
The explanation for why Israel was to turn northward: they were to pass through the territory of Esau's descendants without taking their land, for the Lord had given Mount Se'ir to Esau.
